title: stevia elatior var. coronata
intro: Stevia elatior var. coronata, commonly known as Stevia, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae) that is native to South America. This plant has been widely used for its potential health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing blood sugar levels, and aiding in weight management due to its unique sweet properties. The therapeutic actions of Stevia include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it a popular choice for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include stevioside and rebaudioside, glycosides that provide the plant's sweetness without the calories, as well as other compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
